chapter: Kansas City rooms and Piney Brown
title: Introduction to tape two on personalities and records
summary: Smith says this tape will cover personalities and recording dates and mentions the outline by J. R. Taylor and Martin Williams.

blocks.x: And now ladies and gentlemen this is Tape Two of an interview with Samuel Baby Lovett by Art Smith at the Afterhours, with very able assistance from Charles Crook Goodwin. Now I think this tape we will concentrate on personalities that Baby knew and that Crook knew over the years and on the recording dates, the literally hundreds of records that Baby made.
At some point later on, not on this tape but before this interview is over for the Endowment of the Performing

Arts of the Smithsonian Institution, we do want to cover that really magnificent outline prepared by Mr. Taylor, Mr. J.R. Taylor. We understand that our first tape was liked in Washington and myself, Art Smith, was very happy to have the chance to meet both Mr. Taylor and the famous Martin Williams.
